> Branch management, on a clinic's own subdomain. The first router to use the full middleware chain from CONVENTIONS.md: requireTenant -> authenticate -> requireAuth -> authorize -> validate -> handler The order is the security model, not a style choice. requireTenant first so an unknown host is answered 404 before any credential is examined; authorize after authenticate because it resolves permissions against the caller's active branch; validate last so a malformed body from someone who is not allowed here anyway never reaches Zod.
